messages:
lee: Quick follow-up from the postmortem today on streaming/chat reliability. Need owners + short timelines. Keep it tight.
ops-bot: Created INC-2048 follow-up card: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2048 :spiral_note_pad:
anya: Brief recap: partial streams ~0.6%, handshake timeouts in bursts, client retry loops making things worse.
kai: Proposed actions:
- A1: SDK backoff + jitter (owner: kai) 1d spec, 10d PR
- A2: Server partial-detect + guard (owner: anya) 3w flagged rollout
- A3: Alert + synthetic for partial clusters (owner: sara) 3d to dashboard
- A4: Runbook updates for oncall (owner: lee) 24h
sara: PromQL for alert suggestion:
(sum(rate(chat_stream_partials_total[5m])) / sum(rate(chat_stream_requests_total[5m]))) * 100 > 0.5
Trigger for 3 consecutive 5m windows.
anya: I will add a metric chat.partial_latency_ms (time to first partial) and tag by route/model.
kai: SDK jitter snippet (Go):
func BackoffMillis(attempt int) int { base := 50 * (1 << attempt); if base > 1000 { base = 1000 } jitter := rand.Float64() * 0.35; return int(float64(base) * (1 + jitter)) }
sara: Synthetic plan: inject partial chunk at X ms, measure recovery and reconnect loops, add nightly run to infra-e2e. ETA 9d.
lee: Recurrence detection: cron groups incidents by fingerprint (timeout+partial); if >2 in 30d auto-create infra review. Kai, can you own that?
kai: Yep. Will post issue + cron by EOD: https://git.redwood/p/kai/recurrence-detector
ops-bot: Oncall follow-up rotation assigned: @kai week1, @anya week2.
lee: Please drop PR/issue links in INC-2048 card by COB tomorrow. Short check-in in 48h. Thanks.
